{"metadata":{"description":"Model-facing Office tools for DeepSeek Harness: Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), and PowerPoint (.pptx) create/read/update with workspace-safe paths and PPT image embedding.","id":"gh:1334828310","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-office-tools","slug":"kw78/dsh-office-tools","topics":["deepseek-harness","deepseek-harness-plugin","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugin-market","dsh-plugins","office"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Model-facing Office tools for DeepSeek Harness: Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), and PowerPoint (.pptx) "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"create/read/update with workspace-safe paths and PPT image embedding."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-office-tools"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-office-tools) [](https://github.com/kw78/dsh-office-tools/actio"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"ns/workflows/ci.yml) [](LICENSE) [](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> **If you find this project useful, please give it a ⭐ Star — it helps others find it.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Eight model-facing Office file tools for DeepSeek Harness: create, read, and update Word (`.docx`), "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"Excel (`.xlsx`), and PowerPoint (`.pptx`) files inside the session workspace. Zero runtime dependenc"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ies — every package is generated and parsed by the plugin's own OOXML engine, and every byte crosses"},{"id":"p5s4","text":" the official `ctx.fs` service."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"**Scope:** this is a file generator, not an editor. It creates files and appends to them (`word_upda"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"te` appends; there is no `ppt_update`), `word_create` and each `word_update` write at most one table"},{"id":"p6s3","text":", and PPT images are **linked, not embedded** because the workspace write channel is text-only."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Tools"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Tool | Purpose |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| `word_create` | Create `.docx` (title, paragraphs, bullets, one table) |
| `word_read` | Extract t"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ext; `format: "markdown"` renders structure |
| `word_update` | Append paragraphs, bullets, and/or a"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" table |
| `excel_create` | Create multi-sheet `.xlsx` from cell grids |
| `excel_read` | Read sheet"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"s as rows; formulas return cached values or `'=…'` |
| `excel_update` | Replace/create sheets, or wr"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"ite cells by A1 address |
| `ppt_create` | Create 16:9 `.pptx` (slides, bullets, notes, linked image"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"s) |
| `ppt_read` | Extract text, notes, tables, and per-shape geometry |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Strings starting with `=` become real Excel formulas."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Demo"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"One prompt, a quarterly-report trio:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Positioning"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"A headless OOXML toolkit, not a visual office suite: about 160 KB unpacked, no runtime npm dependenc"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ies (everything is bundled), no local service, no browser, and no telemetry. Every write goes throug"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"h the DSH filesystem service, so behavior is identical in a desktop session and in CI."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| | dsh-office-tools | Visual office suites (e.g. Univer-based plugins) |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Output | Standard `.docx` / `.xlsx` / `.pptx` files | Native document model, exported to Office fo"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"rmats |
| Runtime | Node ≥ 20 only | Local gateway service + headless Chromium |
| Install size | ~1"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"60 KB unpacked | Hundreds of MB |
| Review | Tool results, markdown, wireframe sketches | Live canva"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"s previews and approval cards |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Use a visual suite when you need to see and approve every edit; use this plugin when the agent shoul"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"d produce standard Office files in bulk without extra moving parts."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Restart DSH after installing. Requires a profile that provides the `fs` service (every profile with "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"built-in read/write tools does)."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Notes"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- All paths are confined to the session workspace; `overwrite` defaults to `false`.
- Reads accept a"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ny real package (STORE/DEFLATE) with zip-bomb guards; updates refuse packages with binary parts inst"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ead of corrupting them.
- PPT images are **linked, not embedded**: the sanctioned `ctx.fs` write cha"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"nnel is UTF-8 text only, so a package cannot carry binary image parts. Keep image files next to the "},{"id":"p22s5","text":"deck when moving it, and note that PowerPoint blocks external content by default — a linked picture "},{"id":"p22s6","text":"renders as a "blocked automatic download" placeholder until you enable external content (File → Info"},{"id":"p22s7","text":" → Enable Content, or add the folder under Trust Center → Trusted Locations). This is a PowerPoint s"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"ecurity policy, not a package defect.
- `ppt_create` echoes every element's landing position; `ppt_r"},{"id":"p22s9","text":"ead` returns the same geometry for any deck."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"One option: `enablePptTools` (default `true`) — set it to `false` to coexist with a dedicated presen"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"tation plugin such as dsh-ppt:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Compatibility: `^0.1.0-rc.6 || ^0.1.1-rc.0 || ^0.1.2-alpha.0 || ^0.1.5-alpha.0 || ^0.2.0-rc.1 || ^0."},{"id":"p28s2","text":"2.1-rc.3`; exact tested releases live in `package.json` (`dsh.compatibility.dshReleases`).
